prompt: Put the body of `pop` in order. It must sleep while the queue is empty and check again whenever it wakes up. One line does not belong.
explain: Hold the lock, try to take an item, and if there is none wait on the condvar, which releases the lock while sleeping and hands it back on wake-up. The loop re-checks because wake-ups can be spurious. Dropping the guard first would leave nothing to wait with.
